_why: The structured editor owns rich and literal text insertion. Attachment routing preserves the current document and selection, and plain file URI text remains editable prose.

cases.name: ordinary prose remains with the editor
clipboard image remains a browser file attachment
file URI remains a path attachment
large prose remains a pasted-text attachment
native file clipboard waits for host paths without becoming a text card
a file URI supplied as ordinary text remains prose

attachmentSelection: File and large-text attachment insertion leaves the editor text, selection and history unchanged.
creationFailure: Remove pending state and cancel only the affected draft submission; never insert the full failed paste.

textModes.attachmentPriority: File and large-text routing precedes literal/code paste modes.
textModes.forcedPlain: Replace with literal text, retaining current editor marks and ignoring clipboard formatting.
textModes.code: Insert literal normalized text, remove trailing newlines, and preserve the code block.
textModes.urlOverSelection: Only unmodified URL paste over nonempty prose without inline atoms creates a link, then collapses the caret to the end.
